bio: This renowned winery and hotel enjoys a sensational location amid the vineyards – the terrace overlooking the region beckons in summer! With Wirtshaus, siblings Anna and Markus Sattler propose a charming alternative to their fine dining restaurant. Popular classics and seasonal dishes can be ordered à la carte, and there is also a daily set menu. To complement the dishes, they serve wines from their own estate. Besides the delicious food, the warm hospitality ensures a wonderful dining experience....
